name: Twitch Chat Overlay
description: Your chat on stream, with badges and emotes, read straight from Twitch. Nothing to connect and no bot to add: it works the moment the overlay is in OBS. Ten looks to pick from, from a terminal to speech bubbles to a news ticker, and thirteen controls behind them for the font, the colors, the layout and how long a message stays. Every change lands in OBS as you make it.
changelog: Version 2: a skin control and ten built-in skins, so a preset can change the shape of a message and not only its colors. Version 1 was the initial release: the fourth product, and the first that needs nothing beyond the overlay itself.
ready_message: Your chat is on screen. Design it below to get the look you want, and every change shows in OBS as you make it.
highlights: Names in their Twitch colours, badges, Twitch and third-party emotes, a chip on a first message.
Ten looks, from a terminal to speech bubbles to a news ticker, and thirteen controls for font, colours, layout and how long a message stays.
Nothing to connect and no bot to add. Every change lands in OBS as you make it.

pitch.reasons_heading: Your chat on screen, without the hassle.

reasons.title: Nothing to connect
reasons.body: No bot and no account to link. It reads your Twitch chat directly, like any viewer does.

reasons.title: Ten looks to start from
reasons.body: From a terminal to speech bubbles to a news ticker. Then the font, colours and layout are yours.

reasons.title: Every emote shows up
reasons.body: Twitch emotes plus 7TV, BTTV and FFZ, and the badges your chatters earned.

reasons.title: Keeps going when we don't
reasons.body: Messages come straight from Twitch, not through Overlabels, so chat keeps flowing even if Overlabels has a bad day.

pitch.looks_lede: Pick one in the designer, then tune the font, colours, layout and how long a message stays.
pitch.setup_note: The feed fills whatever box you give it in OBS. 500 by 800 is a good start for a stacked feed, 1920 by 80 for the ticker.

faq.a: Yes. When a moderator deletes a message or times someone out, it comes off your overlay too.

faq.q: Can I hide commands or certain chatters?
faq.a: Yes. You can hide messages that start with `!` and hide chosen accounts, like other bots.

faq.q: Do my viewers need to do anything?
faq.a: No. They chat like they always do.

pitch.closing: Put your chat on screen tonight.

notes: Every message comes from Twitch directly, over the same public connection any chat viewer uses. Nothing passes through Overlabels, so chat keeps flowing even when Overlabels is having a bad day.
Size the OBS browser source to size the chat: the feed fills whatever box you give it. 500 by 800 is a good start for a stacked feed, 1920 by 80 for the ticker.
The feed keeps the most recent 50 messages, which is more than fits on screen. The Chat messages loop limit under Settings, Account shortens it; reload the browser source in OBS after changing it.

presets.label: Clean
presets.blurb: Glass rows, everyone in their own Twitch color. The one you never regret.

presets.label: Terminal
presets.blurb: Green on black in a mono font, a prompt before every name and a cursor blinking on the last line.

presets.label: Bubbles
presets.blurb: Speech bubbles with the name above each one, in a round friendly font. For cozy streams.

presets.label: Neon
presets.blurb: No background, a thin glowing outline and names that light up. Late nights and dark games.

presets.label: Paper
presets.blurb: Cream cards with dark ink and a soft shadow. The light one, for bright rooms and art streams.

presets.label: Broadcast
presets.blurb: A news ticker along the bottom edge, names in caps. Just Chatting and podcast formats.

presets.label: Caption
presets.blurb: Big centred text with a heavy shadow, gone after twelve seconds. Subtitles for IRL and talking-head streams.

presets.label: Pixel
presets.blurb: A pixel font, chunky borders and a hard drop shadow. Retro and indie games.

presets.label: Cards
presets.blurb: Each message its own card, the name as a header bar in the chatter's color, emotes big. Room for slow chats.

presets.label: Vapor
presets.blurb: Pink and cyan on deep purple glass, newest at the top, emotes oversized. For the chat that is mostly emotes anyway.
